versions.content: For reporting these two concurrent states to the BswM , a corre- sponding value of FrSM_BswM_StateType shall be determined as follows: • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE then the according FrSM state is reported, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE then the according FrSM state is reported with the postfix '_ECU_PASSIVE', e.g. FRSM_ONLINE_ECU_PASSIVE

For reporting these two concurrent states to the BswM, a corre- sponding value of FrSM_BswM_StateType shall be determined as follows: • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE then the according FrSM state is reported, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE then the according FrSM state is reported with the postfix ’_ECU_PASSIVE’, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE_ECU_PASSIVE

For reporting these two concurrent states to the BswM , a corre- sponding value of FrSM_BswM_StateType shall be determined as follows: • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE then the according FrSM state is reported, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE • FrSM additional state is FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE then the according FrSM state is reported with the postfix ’_ECU_PASSIVE’, e.g. FRSM_ONLINE_ECU_PASSIVE
